open_items: Fresh full CI evidence across CPython 3.10–3.14 is required; local selected gates do not prove the runtime matrix.
Integrated project/profile validation and CLI/lifecycle diagnosis follow their scheduled steps.

oracle.requirement_contract: Ein SRX-Typ-, Versions-, Operator- oder Auswertungsfehler MUSS Regel-ID, JSON Pointer des Ausdrucksknotens, erwartete und tatsächliche Typen sowie eine Reparaturempfehlung ausgeben.
oracle.scope: Executable SRX 1.0 conformance corpus for 29 operators and all nine concrete Annex U.3 arithmetic decisions; diagnostics preserve rule ID, pointers and types with passive repair hints. Full project/profile/CLI integration and the runtime matrix require separate evidence.

preconditions: Explicit JSON-only caller projections and SRX 1.0 literal expression.
steps: Capture own immutable data; evaluate literal or reject invalid declarations without side effects.
Evaluate any/all/none in array order using lexical item binding, strict Boolean predicates and empty-array identities.
Execute versioned positive, negative, boundary and diagnostic vectors against real SRX APIs; compare typed values and exact error pointers, never presentation strings.

Repeat the full conformance corpus, including all Annex U decisions, under changed Decimal current/default contexts, object-key order, execution order and fresh process defaults; compare machine values/errors and preserve process state.
